task.title: Installing the desktop client
task.shortdesc: Install the client on each computer that takes part in a sync.

step.cmd: Download SyncSetup.exe from the Downloads page and run it.
Download SyncClient.dmg from the Downloads page and drag the client to Applications.
Install the sync-client package with your package manager.
Sign in with your workspace account.
To install the client on many computers, deploy the installer with your device management tool.
Join your team's shared library when the client asks.
Allow the client to start with your session.
